root_cause.mechanism: When direct verifier paths were tests and causal discovery also returned a production file, the classifier always preferred production. That is valid for behavioral assertions but invalid for project-local test harness/setup/runtime exceptions. Fresh test-owned failures were therefore redirected to an already-green production file and the true owner became read-only in the final provider request.

fix.behavior: If every direct project path is a test and current diagnostics contain a recognized harness/setup/runtime exception, keep the direct test owner before causal production candidates. Ordinary assertion failures retain the existing production-owner behavior. TaskRuntime and JobToken remain the write authority.
